title: Soulbound
description: keep inventory without having keep inventory enabled by using a custom enchantment and totem, all configurable
body:
# Soulbound

Soulbound revolutionizes death mechanics on your server by allowing players to protect their most precious items from permanent loss. This enchantment-based plugin adds three levels of Soulbound protection, each providing increasingly powerful preservation mechanics tailored to your server's difficulty and playstyle.

## Core Features
- Three Soulbound Levels - Enchantment levels I, II, and III with distinct recovery chances and mechanics
- Balancing - The total soulbound levels in a inventory can be more than 3 but then your max health is less.
- Enchanting Table Integration - Configurable chances to obtain Soulbound during normal enchanting
- Soul Sand Bonus - Increased enchantment odds when soul sand is placed beneath enchanting tables
- Reincarnation Totems - Custom craftable items offering alternative protection methods
- Admin Commands - Full control with /sb apply, /sb reload, and /sb totem commands
- Fully Configurable - Customize recovery rates, XP requirements, item appearance, and more


## Perfect For
- Survival and SMP servers
- Endgame progression systems
- Balanced difficulty customization

## Known incompatibilities:
1. Hardcore
2. Any LifeSteal plugins
